The '''Kellermin Competition''' was a marksmanship contest held on the planet [[Resti Kel]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boddu Bocck]] was known to participate in the competition.<ref name="AJ1">{{JournalCite|1|Wanted by Cracken (Star Wars Adventure Journal)}}</ref>
